about: Named click points in the Civ4 window for desktop_windows.py click/hover --point NAME. Points are window-relative (physical pixels from the window's top-left corner, title bar included, as in its screenshots), so where the window sits on the screen does not matter; its size does, so each layout is keyed by the window's outer width and height. Each point sits on one line so the points line up like table rows. These points are prone to change: a different game resolution or text scale, or a change to the mod's UI code, moves them. For example, the Sevopedia's category rows follow SAS_CATEGORY_DEFS in Assets/Python/Contrib/Sevopedia/SevoPediaMain.py, so adding or reordering a category shifts every row below it. After such a change, take a screenshot, read the new positions, and update them with their measured date.

pedia_search.note: search box at the top left; typing needs no click: the user's typing and desktop_windows.py type both filtered the entry list once Civ4 was in front (2026-11-11)

pedia_search_clear.note: CLEAR beside the search box: empties it and restores the full entry list, including after a search left the list empty (GPT-6.1-Sol, 2026-11-11)

pedia_jump_bar.note: Index page's 0 1 A..Z jump bar, spanning x 260 to 782; letters are unevenly spaced, so read one off a screenshot

pedia_legend.note: Legend, bottom left: opens a text page explaining the Sevopedia's abbreviations, on which this button is gone (2026-11-11)

pedia_clear.note: CLEAR, bottom left; no visible change with an empty search box, so its effect is untested (2026-11-11)

pedia_back.note: BACK, bottom centre: returned to the previous page; dimmed and without effect on the Legend page (2026-11-11)

pedia_next.note: NEXT, bottom centre: dimmed and without effect on the Legend page; the Right arrow key also acts as NEXT (2026-11-11)

pedia_exit.note: EXIT, bottom right: closed the Sevopedia and returned to the main menu (2026-11-11)

pedia_view_expand.note: EXPAND above the 3D view of a unit, building or bonus page: the model then fills the page

pedia_view_reload.note: RELOAD over an expanded 3D view: redraws the model and resets the camera (2026-11-11)

pedia_view_close.note: CLOSE over an expanded 3D view or leader head: returns to the page

pedia_leader_expand.note: EXPAND above a leader page's leader head; the expanded head moves the attitude and action buttons to the top right

leader_attitude_furious.note: Leader page, red attitude button (SevoPediaLeader.py also maps keys 1 to 5 from Friendly to Furious, untested); the chosen one is drawn larger and the head's mood changes

leader_action_greeting.note: Leader page, 'gr': greeting; key 0 per the source, untested

leader_action_agree.note: Leader page, 'ag': agree; key 7 per the source, untested

leader_action_disagree.note: Leader page, 'dg': disagree; key 6 per the source, untested

pedia_leader_back.note: BACK on leader pages, whose footer is re-centred left of the AI columns: CLEAR 236, previous/next player 368/498 (in a game only), BACK 632, NEXT 764, EXIT 896

pedia_media_play.note: Orange play button at the top right of a Movies or Music entry; clicking a Movies entry already starts its movie

media_prev_group.note: Movie/music player, 1st of 7 buttons: previous group (movies: victories, wonders, projects; music: eras); nothing on the first group; no tooltip (2026-11-11)

media_prev.note: Movie/music player: previous item, named by the label above it in Movies; nothing on the first item (2026-11-11)

media_replay.note: Movie/music player: replay; restarted the current item (2026-11-11)

media_toggle.note: Movie/music player: toggle, a TV in Movies and music notes in Music; switched to the other player (2026-11-11)

media_stop.note: Movie/music player: stop; closed the movie and returned to its page, while Esc or Enter closed the whole Sevopedia (2026-11-11)

media_next.note: Movie/music player: next item; started the next wonder's movie (2026-11-11)

media_next_group.note: Movie/music player, 7th button: next group; Conquest to Angkor Wat to the Internet, Agriculture to Civil Service to Aesthetics (2026-11-11)
